coreCapabilities.title: Enterprise Search
coreCapabilities.description: Natural language queries across all systems

detailSections.title: Enterprise Search Engine
detailSections.description: Ask questions in natural language. Get accurate answers grounded in your enterprise data. No more keyword searches or buried documents.

features.title: Natural Language Queries
features.description: Ask questions like you would to a colleague. The AI understands context, intent, and follows up with clarifications automatically.

features.title: Real-Time Data Retrieval
features.description: Search across live systems. Get up-to-date information from CRM, ERP, databases, and cloud storage in milliseconds.

features.title: Contextual Answer Generation
features.description: Not just links—get synthesized answers with citations, summaries, and actionable insights pulled from multiple sources.

detailSections.title: Universal Connectors
detailSections.description: Connect to any enterprise system. 100+ pre-built integrations with CRM, ERP, databases, cloud storage, and communication platforms.

features.title: Plug-and-Play Integration
features.description: Pre-built connectors for Salesforce, SAP, Microsoft 365, ServiceNow, Slack, and 100+ more. Deploy in minutes, not months.

features.title: Real-Time Data Sync
features.description: Bi-directional sync keeps your data fresh. Changes in connected systems reflect instantly in search results.

features.title: Custom Connector SDK
features.description: Need a proprietary system? Build custom connectors with our SDK. Full control over data mapping and transformation.

detailSections.title: Intelligent Data Processing
detailSections.description: Automatic document parsing, smart chunking, and multi-modal extraction. Turn unstructured data into searchable, actionable knowledge.

features.title: Automatic Document Parsing
features.description: PDFs, Word docs, spreadsheets, presentations—automatically extracted and indexed. Text, tables, images, all searchable.

features.title: Smart Chunking & Segmentation
features.description: AI-powered document segmentation preserves context. Paragraphs, sections, chapters—chunked intelligently for optimal retrieval.

features.title: Multi-Modal Extraction
features.description: Extract meaning from images, charts, diagrams. Vision models understand visual content and make it searchable.

governancePillars.title: Complete Audit Trails
governancePillars.description: Every query and data access logged for compliance

governancePillars.title: Permission-Aware Search
governancePillars.description: Only returns results users have access to

governancePillars.title: Compliance Built-In
governancePillars.description: SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA compliance out of the box
